results.title: You Can Now Watch What's Happening Inside Your Mouth With Dyson's CameraJet Toothbrush
results.description: Summary The Dyson CameraJet is the brand's first oral-care device to embed a macro-lens camera that identifies interdental gaps as you brushA conical jet fires precise bursts of liquid into those gaps to lift plaque, working alongside a dual-bristle head and high-frequency sonic motorThe system pairs with the MyDyson app for live in-mouth footage, coverage mapping and technique feedback The Dyson CameraJet electric toothbrush is the brand's most sensor-heavy oral-care play yet, built around a technology Dyson calls Gap Optical Targeting. Rather than leaving the gaps between teeth to a separate flossing step, the device sees them, targets them and cleans them while the brush is still in motion.The centerpiece is a 100k-pixel macro-lens camera housed in the head. It captures 28 images every second, feeding them to an onboard AI machine-learning algorithm that pinpoints interdental gaps. A dome-shaped target lens widens the camera's field of view to sharpen detection, while a stroboscopic light supplies the illumination the lens needs to read the mouth accurately.Once a gap is identified, the cleaning happens through a conical jet that releases up to 0.15ml of liquid between the teeth. A diaphragm pump delivers that pressurized burst in as little as a tenth of a second, and an anti-gravity tank is engineered so the diaphragm expands to cut out air pockets, keeping the jet effective no matter the angle the brush is held at. Dyson developed the conical shape against a lab-based proxy plaque, positioning the sweep of the jet as more thorough than a needle-style stream.A powerful sonic motor drives variable oscillation at 245 movements per second, with an anti-stall action that keeps the bristles moving to lift more plaque. The precisely contoured dual-bristle head cleans along the gumline and is RFID-enabled, so it flags its own wear and signals when a replacement is due, while a silicone-backed sonic dampener softens the feel in hand. Users can run three cleaning modes, brushing and flossing together, floss-only or brush-only, layered over three intensity settings from Gentle to Deep clean, with onboard sensors calling out excess pressure or poor technique.Connectivity rounds out the package through the MyDyson app over Wi-Fi. Beyond guided cleaning, coverage mapping and trend data, the standout is live viewing: the intraoral camera streams cleaning footage in real time so the user can watch what a dentist would normally see. Dyson notes those images are processed on the device or in the app and are never stored or shared. On the durability side, the CameraJet carries an IPX7 waterproof rating, a battery rated for roughly 10 days of use, USB-C to pogo-pin charging and a swappable battery meant to extend the device's lifespan.The Dyson CameraJet electric toothbrush with flosser in Ceramic pink is available to pre-order now via Dyson, with shipping set to begin September 8. results.title: Reebok Softens Its Classics Into Slip-On Territory With Suede Mules and Slides
results.description: Name: Reebok Classic Mule, Reebok Classic SlideColorway: TaupeSKU: RESO6FS1UG2MSRP: TBC (Global), ₩99,000 KRW (approx. $70 USD)Release Date: TBC (Global), Available now (Korea)Where to Buy: Reebok KoreaReebok is loosening up its most recognizable franchise, reworking the Classic into two slip-on shapes: the Classic Mule and the Classic Slide. Both strip the silhouette down to its essentials and lean into comfort-first, warm-weather styling without abandoning the cues that made the original a lifestyle staple.The Classic Mule keeps a closed-toe construction, layering suede panels across the upper and threading in subtle Vector-inspired detailing along the sides for a nod to Reebok's archive. The Classic Slide takes the opposite route, paring things back to overlapping suede straps that read as pure summer utility. It is the same design vocabulary pulled in two directions, one built for a bit more coverage and one for the least possible fuss.Both pairs arrive in a soft taupe finish, and that monochromatic treatment is doing a lot of the heavy lifting. By keeping the entire upper tonal, Reebok pushes these firmly into the neutral, easy-to-style lane that has come to define much of the modern slip-on market. Branding stays deliberately quiet, with tonal detailing throughout and Classic logos tucked onto the footbeds rather than shouted across the upper. Cushioned footbeds round out the package, positioning both as genuine wear-all-day options rather than novelty pieces.The move fits a broader pattern of heritage sneaker lines being reshaped into laceless, lifestyle-forward formats, letting a familiar name reach an audience that wants the look with none of the setup. For Reebok, the Mule and Slide are a low-risk way to keep the Classic in rotation year-round, extending an iconic shape into territory built entirely around ease.The Reebok Classic Mule and Classic Slide have already been released in Korea. A US launch has yet to be announced, so stateside shoppers will need to wait for confirmed details. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

results.title: Woman stabs 2 people in New York City’s Times Square, killing 1, then is killed by police
results.description: A woman randomly stabbed two people in New York City’s Times Square on Monday, killing one woman, and then was fatally shot by police, according to officials. The shooting happened just before 4:30 p.m. next to a New York Police Department substation, just outside One Times Square, the building that hosts the city’s annual New Year’s Eve ball drop celebration. It is one of the most heavily touristed and policed spots in all of New York. The 49-year-old woman from Queens pulled out two knives from a shopping bag and stabbed a 68-year-old man who had just come out of the subway station and was waiting to cross the street with his wife, striking him in the abdomen, Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch said at a news conference. Seconds later, the woman stabbed a 32-year-old woman also in the abdomen, Tisch said. Both victims were taken to the hospital. The woman died and the man is in stable condition, according to police. Police didn’t say if the victims were tourists visiting the city or residents.
